subject: Expressions
notes: Rule 4 (cite.py --check 8.8.2 "The two operands in a binary boolean operation shall not both be the figurative constant ALL literal" -> OK §8.8.2 4)). MakeBoolBinary reports COBOL1511 when both operands are BoundBoolAll{IsAllLiteral:true}; figurative ZERO carries IsAllLiteral=false (kb/Work PB157, landed) so `ZERO B-AND ALL B"1"` is legal. PROBE N01 `ALL B"1" B-AND ALL B"0"` -> COBOL1511 citing rule 4; p1b `A B-XOR ALL B"10"` = 0110 accepted. The check is in the one resolver callback, so it rides every site (COMPUTE, conditions, arguments). No test exercises the prohibition (grep of tests for the 1511 rule-4 message: none) -> test-ref empty. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2002, 2014, 2023 (boolean expressions and B-AND/B-OR/B-XOR/B-NOT are a COBOL-2002 introduction - the in-repo 2023 text's Annex E carries only the 2014->2023 delta, so the 2002 introduction is taken from the clause's absence in 85 and the probe gate COBOL0900 at --std 85)
